def is_latin(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    for row in grid:
        if set(row) != set(range(n)):
            return False
    for col in range(n):
        if set(grid[r][col] for r in range(n)) != set(range(n)):
            return False
    return True
def check_ortho(X, Y):
    n = len(X)
    pairs = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            p = (X[i][j], Y[i][j])
            if p in pairs:
                return False
            pairs.add(p)
    return len(pairs) == n*n
